text: a sprawling wraparound mural concept for the childrens library east wall showing a parade of woodland animals a fox a bear an owl a hedgehog and a family of rabbits marching under paper lanterns through a birch forest at dusk with fireflies picked out in gold leaf and every animal carrying one book from a different genre mystery poetry cookbooks atlases and the whole scene framed by climbing ivy that spells out small words where the leaves cluster read wander wonder
